column1: Condition or Deficiency,Causes,Symptoms,Dietary Fix,Specific Ingredients,Optimal Macro Profile,Key Micros,Life Stage Guidance

Obesity,"Excess caloric intake, poor diet quality, sedentary lifestyle","Weight gain, fatigue, joint pain, increased risk of other chronic diseases","Calorie control, increase fiber and protein, reduce ultra-processed foods","Leafy greens, lentils, berries, skinless poultry, oats","Protein 30%, Fat 25%, Carbs 45%","Fiber, Vitamin D, Chromium, Magnesium",Adults (19-50): Emphasize nutrient density and portion control

Type 2 Diabetes,"High sugar/refined carb intake, obesity, sedentary lifestyle","Frequent urination, thirst, fatigue, blurred vision","Low-glycemic foods, high fiber, lean proteins, regular meals","Quinoa, chia seeds, beans, leafy greens, fatty fish","Protein 25%, Fat 30%, Carbs 45% (low GI)","Magnesium, Chromium, Vitamin D",Adults (30-70): Prioritize glycemic control with balanced meals

Hypertension,"High sodium, low potassium/magnesium/calcium intake","Often asymptomatic, may include headaches or vision issues","Reduce sodium, increase fruits, vegetables, and whole grains","Bananas, sweet potatoes, spinach, low-fat dairy, beets","Protein 20%, Fat 25%, Carbs 55%","Potassium, Magnesium, Calcium",Older adults (50+): Apply DASH diet principles

Cardiovascular Disease,"Saturated/trans fats, cholesterol, sugar, sedentary habits","Chest pain, shortness of breath, fatigue, heart attack/stroke","Increase omega-3s, fiber; reduce saturated fat","Salmon, walnuts, oats, flaxseed, olive oil","Protein 20%, Fat 30%, Carbs 50%","Omega-3s, Fiber, Vitamin E, Magnesium","Men 40+, Women 50+: Emphasize lipid control and inflammation reduction"

Dyslipidemia,"Trans fats, added sugars, low fiber, obesity",No symptoms usually; detected via blood test,"Reduce trans fats, increase fiber and omega-3 intake","Avocados, flaxseed, beans, fatty fish, vegetables","Protein 20%, Fat 30%, Carbs 50%","Niacin, Omega-3s, Fiber",Adults (40+): Lifestyle therapy is first line of treatment

Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD),High fructose consumption and obesity,"Fatigue, discomfort in upper right abdomen","Reduce fructose and added sugars, lose weight, increase omega-3s","Cruciferous vegetables, oats, berries, sardines","Protein 25%, Fat 30%, Carbs 45%","Vitamin E, Omega-3s, Choline",Adults with metabolic syndrome: Focus on weight reduction and insulin sensitivity

Metabolic Syndrome,"High sugar and fat intake, sedentary lifestyle","Abdominal obesity, high BP, insulin resistance","Weight loss, low-sugar diet, high fiber, exercise","Lentils, avocados, greens, whole grains, salmon","Protein 25%, Fat 30%, Carbs 45%","Magnesium, Chromium, Fiber","Adults (35-65): Reduce waist circumference, improve lipid panel"

Certain Cancers (Colorectal, Breast, Prostate),"Processed/red meats, low produce intake","Depends on type���can include weight loss, fatigue, pain","Plant-forward diet, high fiber, limit red/processed meats","Berries, cruciferous vegetables, legumes, garlic","Protein 20%, Fat 25%, Carbs 55%","Antioxidants (A, C, E), Selenium, Fiber",Middle age and older adults: Preventative with plant-based diversity

Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD),"High sodium and animal protein intake, uncontrolled diabetes or hypertension","Fatigue, fluid retention, urinary changes","Limit sodium and protein, manage diabetes and blood pressure","Cabbage, red bell peppers, garlic, apples, egg whites","Protein 10���15%, Fat 30%, Carbs 55%","Low Sodium, Phosphorus, Potassium (if advanced CKD)",Adults: Tailor diet to stage of CKD and comorbidities

Gout,"High purines, alcohol, sugary drinks","Joint pain, swelling, redness (especially big toe)","Avoid alcohol, organ meats, increase hydration and plant foods","Cherries, celery, cucumber, coffee, tofu","Protein 15%, Fat 25%, Carbs 60%","Vitamin C, Folate, Potassium","Middle-aged men: Avoid triggers, maintain healthy BMI"

Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD),"High-fat meals, alcohol, caffeine, obesity, smoking","Heartburn, regurgitation, chest pain, sore throat","Eat smaller meals, avoid trigger foods, low-fat intake","Oatmeal, bananas, steamed vegetables, lean turkey, aloe juice","Protein 20%, Fat 25%, Carbs 55%",None specific; focus on gut-soothing foods,"Adults: Avoid high-fat and spicy foods, do not eat close to bedtime"

Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS),"Unknown; may involve gut-brain interaction, FODMAP sensitivity","Bloating, cramping, diarrhea, constipation","Low-FODMAP diet, increase soluble fiber","Oats, zucchini, carrots, bananas, chicken","Balanced, focus on soluble fiber","Magnesium, Soluble Fiber",Young adults: Test tolerance to FODMAP-rich foods; track triggers

Gallbladder Disease (Gallstones),"High-fat diets, rapid weight loss, obesity","Abdominal pain after eating, nausea, bloating","Low-fat, moderate-fiber diet","Beets, apples, brown rice, leafy greens, fish","Protein 20%, Fat 20%, Carbs 60%","Vitamin C, Fiber",Women >40: Emphasize healthy weight and dietary fat moderation

PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome),"Insulin resistance, hormonal imbalance","Irregular periods, acne, weight gain","Low-glycemic, anti-inflammatory diet","Chia seeds, salmon, kale, berries, lentils","Protein 25%, Fat 30%, Carbs 45% (low GI)","Magnesium, Zinc, Vitamin D, Omega-3s",Women 15-40: Combine dietary changes with lifestyle support

Dental Caries (Tooth Decay),"High sugar intake, low calcium, poor hygiene","Tooth pain, sensitivity, visible decay","Reduce sugar, increase mineral intake","Cheese, apples, green tea, yogurt, nuts",Standard with minimal sugar,"Calcium, Phosphorus, Vitamin D",Children and adults: Limit sugary snacks and sip water frequently

Osteoporosis,"Low calcium and vitamin D, menopause, aging","Fractures, back pain, loss of height","Increase calcium, vitamin D, weight-bearing exercise","Milk, sardines, kale, almonds, fortified OJ","Protein 20%, Fat 30%, Carbs 50%","Calcium, Vitamin D, Vitamin K, Magnesium","Women 50+, Men 70+: Aim for 1200 mg Ca/day"

Depression and Anxiety (Nutrition-Linked),"Inflammation, low omega-3 and B vitamins","Low mood, fatigue, restlessness",Increase anti-inflammatory and brain-supporting nutrients,"Fatty fish, spinach, berries, eggs, sunflower seeds","Protein 25%, Fat 30%, Carbs 45%","Omega-3s, B6, B12, Magnesium",All adults: Omega-3s >250 mg/day; avoid alcohol and excess sugar

Anemia (Iron Deficiency),Low intake or absorption of iron,"Fatigue, cold intolerance, pale skin",Boost heme iron and absorption-enhancers like vitamin C,"Beef, lentils, tofu, spinach, bell peppers","Protein 20%, Fat 30%, Carbs 50%","Iron, Vitamin C, Folate",Women 14-50: 18 mg/day iron; teens and pregnant women at highest risk

Eating Disorders (e.g., Anorexia, Binge Eating),"Psychological, cultural, dietary restriction","Weight changes, anxiety, preoccupation with food",Nutritional rehabilitation and therapy,"Nut butters, whole grains, full-fat dairy, eggs, avocado",Gradual increase to balanced macros,All essential nutrients depending on deficiency,Adolescents and young adults: Medical supervision required for refeeding

Zinc Deficiency,"Low intake, high-phytate diets","Poor wound healing, taste changes, low immunity",Increase zinc-dense foods,"Oysters, beef, pumpkin seeds, cashews",Balanced; emphasize protein sources,"Zinc, Vitamin A, Vitamin C","Men: 11 mg/day; Women: 8 mg/day, with higher needs during pregnancy"

Vitamin D Deficiency,"Low sun exposure, poor intake, obesity, darker skin","Fatigue, bone/muscle weakness, frequent illness","Consume Vitamin D-rich or fortified foods, safe sun exposure","Salmon, fortified milk, egg yolks, mushrooms, cod liver oil","Protein 15���20%, Fat 30%, Carbs 50���55%","Vitamin D, Calcium, Magnesium",All adults: 600-800 IU/day; seniors and those indoors need supplements

Magnesium Deficiency,"Low intake, alcoholism, medication effects","Muscle cramps, fatigue, arrhythmia",Add magnesium-rich plant foods,"Almonds, spinach, black beans, whole grains","Balanced: Protein 20%, Fat 30%, Carbs 50%","Magnesium, Potassium, B6",All adults: 310-420 mg/day; older adults often require supplementation

Vitamin B12 Deficiency,"Low animal product intake, absorption issues","Numbness, fatigue, cognitive impairment",Increase animal foods or fortified products,"Liver, clams, dairy, fortified plant milks","Standard: Protein 15���20%, Fat 30%, Carbs 50���55%","B12, Folate, Iron",Older adults: monitor absorption and consider B12 supplements

Folate Deficiency,"Low intake of vegetables, alcoholism","Fatigue, poor concentration, birth defects in pregnancy",Increase folate-rich plants and fortified grains,"Spinach, lentils, oranges, asparagus, fortified cereals",Standard with focus on plant diversity,"Folate, B12, Iron",Women of childbearing age: 400-600 mcg DFE/day

Constipation (Functional),"Low fiber intake, dehydration, inactivity","Infrequent, hard stools, bloating, straining",Increase fiber and fluid intake,"Prunes, oats, chia seeds, flaxseed, apples, lentils","Standard: Protein 15%, Fat 30%, Carbs 55%","Fiber, Magnesium, Fluids",Adults: Fiber 25-38g/day; children: 5g + age in years

Omega-3 Deficiency,"Low seafood intake, high omega-6/omega-3 ratio","Dry skin, fatigue, mood issues, inflammation",Include omega-3 rich foods,"Salmon, flaxseed, chia seeds, walnuts, sardines",Standard; focus on quality fats,"EPA, DHA, ALA, Vitamin E",All adults: Aim for 250-500 mg EPA/DHA per day

Vitamin A Deficiency,"Low intake of colorful fruits/vegetables, fat malabsorption","Poor vision, dry eyes/skin, immune dysfunction",Increase vitamin A and beta-carotene intake,"Carrots, sweet potatoes, spinach, liver, kale",Standard balanced profile,"Vitamin A, Zinc, Healthy fats (for absorption)",Children and pregnant women: critical for vision and development

Iodine Deficiency,Low intake of iodized salt or seafood,"Goiter, hypothyroidism, cognitive impairment",Consume iodine-rich foods or iodized salt,"Seaweed, iodized salt, dairy, eggs, cod",Standard balanced intake,"Iodine, Selenium, Tyrosine",Pregnant women: 220 mcg/day; general adults: 150 mcg/day

Celiac Disease,Autoimmune response to gluten,"Bloating, diarrhea, fatigue, anemia","Strict gluten-free diet, restore nutrients","Brown rice, quinoa, chickpeas, leafy greens, gluten-free grains",Balanced diet with anti-inflammatory focus,"Iron, Folate, B12, Calcium, Vitamin D",Adolescents and adults: Monitor for malabsorption; correct deficiencies

Chronic Inflammation (Systemic),"High sugar/fat diets, low antioxidants, stress","Fatigue, joint pain, increased disease risk","Anti-inflammatory diet, increase phytonutrients","Turmeric, blueberries, olive oil, green tea, leafy greens","Protein 25%, Fat 30%, Carbs 45%","Polyphenols, Vitamin C, Omega-3s, Magnesium",All adults: Use whole food plant-based diversity to modulate inflammation

Hyperthyroidism (Graves' Disease),"Autoimmune condition often not caused by diet, but influenced by iodine","Weight loss, rapid heartbeat, irritability, heat intolerance","Avoid iodine excess, support balanced nutrition","Cruciferous vegetables (moderation), selenium-rich foods, whole grains","Protein 20%, Fat 25%, Carbs 55%","Selenium, Zinc, Vitamin D","Adults: Manage iodine intake, support immune balance"

Hypothyroidism,"Autoimmune (Hashimoto���s), iodine deficiency","Fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, depression",Ensure adequate iodine and selenium intake,"Seaweed (in moderation), Brazil nuts, eggs, dairy","Protein 20%, Fat 30%, Carbs 50%","Iodine, Selenium, Zinc, Vitamin D","Middle-aged women: Screen for thyroid issues, support metabolism"

ADHD (Nutritional Support Role),"Multifactorial, diet influences behavior and attention","Inattention, hyperactivity, impulsivity","Eliminate artificial colors, support omega-3, protein balance","Oily fish, eggs, nuts, leafy greens, whole grains","Protein 25%, Fat 30%, Carbs 45%","Iron, Zinc, Omega-3s, Magnesium, B-vitamins","Children and adolescents: Stable meals, avoid food additives"

Insomnia (Diet-Linked),"Caffeine, alcohol, sugar, low magnesium or tryptophan",Difficulty falling or staying asleep,"Avoid stimulants, promote sleep-supportive foods","Pumpkin seeds, kiwi, almonds, tart cherry juice, oatmeal","Protein 20%, Fat 25%, Carbs 55%","Magnesium, Tryptophan, Melatonin, B6",All ages: Emphasize evening nutrition and avoid late caffeine

Prediabetes,"Insulin resistance, high sugar intake, overweight","Often asymptomatic, may include fatigue, hunger, blurred vision","Control carb intake, increase fiber, weight loss support","Leafy greens, whole grains, legumes, avocado, berries","Protein 25%, Fat 30%, Carbs 45% (low GI)","Magnesium, Chromium, Fiber, Vitamin D",Adults with BMI >25: Prioritize prevention and reversal
